what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from the Philippines in Japan: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2017, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 5298 Philippine asylum seekers in Japan, 65.6% of all asylum seekers from the Philippines.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of the Philippines with the CPP from 1999 to 2025, and over Mindanao territory from 1998 to 2020.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2016 to 2024.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 2003, at 6 asylum seekers, to 2017.
Its highest and last figure is for 2017, the main year of displacement in the data.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Japan.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Japan only; the data has no figure after 2017.
